title: OpenLineage Pipeline Run Failures
dataSources: Catalog audit events (`collibra:audit`, `atlan:audit`, `datahub:audit`), OpenLineage run events (`openlineage:event`), Unity Catalog audit logs, Purview scan/classification results, stewardship and access-policy change events.
app: Collibra / Alation / Atlan / DataHub / Microsoft Purview / Databricks Unity Catalog audit logs and REST APIs via HEC scripted inputs; OpenLineage/Marquez events via HEC.
spl:
index=dataops sourcetype=openlineage:event eventType=COMPLETE
| stats count as runs, sum(eval(run_state="FAILED")) as failures by job_namespace, job_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Consumes OpenLineage run events to track pipeline job outcomes across tools with a vendor-neutral lineage standard, unifying failure visibility.
value: OpenLineage gives one failure signal across many orchestration tools; correlating it with lineage shows exactly which downstream datasets a failure affects.
implementation: Emit OpenLineage events to HEC (or via Marquez); schedule hourly; alert on failures; join to lineage for impact.
visualization: Table of failing jobs, lineage-impact view.
grandmaExplanation: We track data jobs across all your tools in one standard way and flag failures, showing what downstream data they affect.
